name: Mahalat
title: Rehoboam's wife
summary: Mahalat was one of King Rehoboam's wives, the granddaughter of David through Jerimoth. She bore him sons Jeush, Shemariah and Saham.

keyEvents.title: Rehoboam's wife
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam took Mahalat as his wife, a granddaughter of David, and she bore him several sons.
